intro: Meet Dual Pro - a modern marvel that combines safety, durability, and elegance. Designed for contemporary living, it offers functionality wrapped in style, making it perfect for your living space.

features.title: Sleek and safe tempered glass top
features.text: Features a sleek tempered glass top with bevelled edges, ensuring a smooth and safe surface that’s both stylish and durable​.

features.title: Soft-close drawer for peaceful living
features.text: Integrated soft-close hinges prevent noisy bangs, ensuring a serene and peaceful experience every time you access storage compartments​.

features.title: Built to last, designed for life
features.text: Constructed with E2P2 board for enhanced longevity, the table is built to withstand daily wear and tear with ease​.

features.title: Family-friendly rounded edges
features.text: Rounded edges eliminate sharp corners, offering a safe environment for families while maintaining a polished aesthetic​.

features.title: Enhanced strength with UV disc upgrade
features.text: Upgraded to high grade UV disc, the table offers improved structural integrity, making it a reliable and robust addition to your home​.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
